title: EXEC SQL without SQLCODE / SQLSTATE check
description: Embedded SQL with no SQLCODE / SQLSTATE inspection after the call and no WHENEVER directive in effect. Unhandled SQL errors are a common source of silent data corruption in COBOL.
suggestedReplacement:
EXEC SQL ... END-EXEC.
    IF SQLCODE NOT = ZERO
        PERFORM HANDLE-SQL-ERROR
    END-IF.
